description: Code-behind for the TheoryExam page in an online examination system, handling question loading, answer submission, session management, and navigation.

classes.name: TheoryExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for the TheoryExam ASP.NET page, managing exam questions, timing, and answer submission.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page load event; loads questions from database, initializes timer.

methods.description: Returns course name based on course ID.
